fairness: The CRM and the shop number their records independently (both start at 1, as the row examples show), and the store replaces a record with the same id. Overwriting a CRM contact with an unrelated shop contact is data loss under the request's own terms. The hidden tests import both sources with overlapping numbers, and re-run an import.
naive: Uses customer_no as the id, so shop contact 17 overwrites CRM contact 17.
